name: Vscodium-web
tagline: A community-driven, freely-licensed binary distribution of the remote host web component of Microsoft's editor VS Code.
description: Vscodium-web is a community-driven, freely-licensed binary distribution of the remote host web component of Microsoft's editor VS Code.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/vscodium-web:1.140.06880@sha256:e263889f8c040ac221144dd19e7ae9469e1b6f20c25acdca5694ef7eb6a9f514
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      CONNECTION_TOKEN: ''
      CONNECTION_TOKEN_FILE: ''
      SUDO_PASSWORD: ''
      SUDO_PASSWORD_HASH: ''
      CODE_ARGS: ''
    ports:
      - target: 8000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
